personalInfo.title: Full Stack Developer
personalInfo.profile: Dynamic Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience specializing in Vue.js, Laravel, PHP, and MySQL. Proven track record in UX/UI programming, seamless Git-based workflows, and Docker deployments. Expert in GenAI integration, designing advanced prompt engineering pipelines to automate configurations. Combines strong collaborative skills with clean code principles to build scalable web applications and high-impact digital solutions.

responsibilities: Engineered and deployed over 50 fully responsive, high-fidelity web applications utilizing Bootstrap and Vue/JavaScript to deliver optimized, cross-device UX/UI experiences.
Spearheaded legacy content migration using automated Python scripts to ensure data integrity across newly deployed systems.
Designed custom prompt engineering templates and AI configurations to automate design workflows and accelerate frontend production.
Architected full-stack web applications by integrating Laravel/PHP backend services with Vue.js frontends under Specification-Driven Development (SDD) patterns.
Optimized application components and MySQL database queries, improving system responsiveness and resolving performance bottlenecks through clean code practices.
Orchestrated Docker containerized environments and deployment pipelines, implementing prompt-driven GenAI integration layers to connect web backends with LLMs.
Engineered secure RESTful APIs leveraging PHP, Python, and Node.js to achieve seamless data exchange and high-performance system integration.
Streamlined application deployment workflows using Git version control and automated testing pipelines to ensure continuous, reliable production releases.
Optimized schema designs and transactional queries for MySQL and PostgreSQL databases, improving data retrieval speeds and maintaining structural integrity.
